description:
Elevated rental living in the heart of Birmingham.
Welcome to Cortland Broad St. - contemporary apartments designed around the way you want to live, with exceptional resident spaces, a dedicated on-site team and Birmingham city centre right outside your door.
Inside, you'll find spacious, light-filled apartments finished to a high standard. Contemporary kitchens feature energy-efficient appliances and quality work surfaces, while stylish bathrooms, modern flooring and carefully considered fixtures and fittings create a home that feels comfortable from the moment you move in.
And your home extends far beyond your apartment.
Start your morning in the 24/7 Fitness Centre, work remotely from the flexible co-working spaces, relax in the private courtyard or head up to the Sky Lounge and Roof Terrace to unwind above the city.
Designed for more than just living:

*	Sky Lounge & Roof Terrace
*	24/7 Fitness Centre & Flexible Studio
*	Private Courtyard Garden
*	Business Lounge & Flexible Co-Working Space
*	Resident Lounge
*	Bookable Private Suites
*	Dedicated Dog Park
*	WiFi Included
*	On-Site Team & Maintenance Support

When you want to explore, you're perfectly placed. Brindleyplace is just minutes away, with Birmingham's restaurants, bars, entertainment and cultural destinations all within easy reach, plus nearby Metro links connecting you across the city.
There's a real sense of community too, with regular resident events and a friendly on-site team available around the clock.
Bringing a four-legged housemate? They're welcome too. Cortland Broad St. is proudly pet-friendly, complete with its own dedicated dog park.
Find your space in the city. Enquire today and book your viewing at Cortland Broad St.
Please note: All images, floorplans and particulars are provided for illustrative and indicative purposes only. Individual apartment features, furnishings and layouts may vary.
keyFeatures: Communal Sky Lounge and Terrace with city views
150mb high-speed WiFi - included in your rent
Located just minutes from Brindley Place and the city's best bars, & restaurants
